newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 6-,9-12-mo T-bill yields edged up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 6-,9-12-mo T-bill yields edged up slightly.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month, nine-month and 12-months Ukraine discount treasury bills edged up slightly from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Tuesday.
Six-month bills firmed to 20.15 percent from 20.13 percent, nine-month bills sneaked up to 28.14 percent from 28.13 percent, and 12-month bills moved up slightly to 30.48 percent from 30.46 percent.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 15.00 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Amount sold 15.00 million UAH 13.62 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.63 million UAH 12.38 million UAH
The central bank sold 150,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for June 19.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 38.00 million UAH 38.00 million UAH
Amount sold 38.00 million UAH 38.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 31.39 million UAH 31.39 million UAH
The central bank sold 380,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for June 19.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 60.00 million UAH 60.00 million UAH
Amount sold 60.00 million UAH 60.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 46.01 million UAH 46.02 million UAH
The central bank sold 600,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for June 19.
